THE PROBLEM

In-house teams and service firms want AI automation without building and validating it themselves.

CAPABILITIES

What it does.

  • Configurable workflows
  • Reviewer console
  • Model gateway
  • Evaluation harness with gold sets
  • Full audit trail
  • Tenant isolation
  • Connection to existing safety databases via E2B(R3) (planned)
HOW IT WORKS

Five steps, every time.

  1. 01Configure the workflow

    Steps, thresholds and routing are configured to match how your safety operation already works.

  2. 02Connect the models

    The model gateway puts every model call behind one controlled, logged interface.

  3. 03Give reviewers a console

    Your qualified reviewers accept, correct or escalate in the same console Vyom uses.

  4. 04Hold the quality bar

    An evaluation harness runs gold sets against every model, prompt or rule change before it ships.

  5. 05Operate

    A full audit trail and tenant isolation underneath, with connection to existing safety databases via E2B(R3) planned.
